narr: Thunderstorms developed along a dryline and moved through the northeastern part of South Central Texas. These storms formed in a strongly unstable airmass producing large hail, damaging wind gusts, and some localized flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that flooded a road southeast of Burnet.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to street flooding in Burnet.
